messages:
dina: Heads-up — async-embedder is seeing a jump in 5xx for long-context requests after the last canary. We traced it to a race in the kv-cache in the quant path. Need an expedited hotfix: redwood/embedder:fix-2026-03. Request cut within 35m. Rollout plan: 5% -> 20% (10m) -> 100% if green. Rollback criteria: 5xx +0.4% absolute OR p95 latency +300ms sustained for 3m OR any pod OOM. @sre-oncall @release-eng
chris: I can own the deploy. Confirming no DB/schema changes. Please exclude apac-edge from canary due to concurrent maintenance.
sre-oncall: Oncall ack — monitoring dashboards ready, will trigger rollback on thresholds. Tagging incident INC-185777.
deploy-bot: Release request accepted for redwood/embedder:fix-2026-03. ETA start 1857778920. Canary plan: 5% in eu region (embedder-eu-canary).
release-eng: Drafting release blurb: "Fix race in kv-cache causing intermittent 5xx for long-context async embeddings; no data migration required." Will publish after final link.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 1857778920 on pool embedder-eu-canary (5%).
chris: Quick smoke: canary 5xx 0.02%, p95 150ms. Traces look clean.
deploy-bot: Advanced to 20% at 1857779000. Running 10m verification window.
sre-oncall: Metrics stable, mem and RSS fine. No OOMs. Proceed if holds.
pm-ops: Approved expedited ramp to 100% after holds; apac excluded confirmed.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1857779100. No automated rollback triggered.
dina: Deployed to prod; monitoring passive traffic for 20m and will file a short incident summary. Final release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/1857778888-embedder-kvcache-fix
chris: Nice work team. :thumbsup:
